items.title: Terry Clark — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: we had a lot of Stan Kenton music that he had given to George

ctx.x: What was your repertoire at that time?

We played a lot of stocks – popular tunes – and we had a lot of Stan Kenton music that he had given to George, and we had a lot of old Basie music that Basie had given to George. So it was a good band with a good repertoire.
That’s an interesting, jumping from Basie to Stan Kenton. That’s a pretty big leap.
